name: IndexBlockScore
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import json
import os
SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE = 128


def run(idx_q, index_kv_cache, block_table, cu_seqlens, seq_lens, prefix_lens):
    assert idx_q.dim() == 3, f'idx_q 应为 3D, got {idx_q.shape}'
    total_q, H, D = idx_q.shape
    P, BS, D2 = index_kv_cache.shape
    assert BS == SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE and D2 == D, f'cache 形状应为 [P, 128, {D}], got {index_kv_cache.shape}'
    B, max_block = block_table.shape
    assert cu_seqlens.shape[0] == B + 1
    assert seq_lens.shape[0] == B and prefix_lens.shape[0] == B
    assert int(cu_seqlens[-1]) == total_q
    q = idx_q.float()
    score = torch.full((H, total_q, max_block), float('-inf'), dtype=torch.float32, device=idx_q.device)
    arange_bs = torch.arange(BS, device=idx_q.device)
    for b in range(B):
        s = int(cu_seqlens[b])
        e = int(cu_seqlens[b + 1])
        q_len = e - s
        if q_len == 0:
            continue
        prefix = int(prefix_lens[b])
        seq_len = int(seq_lens[b])
        hi = min(seq_len, prefix + q_len)
        nb = min((hi + BS - 1) // BS, max_block)
        abs_pos = prefix + torch.arange(q_len, device=idx_q.device)
        for blk in range(nb):
            page = int(block_table[b, blk])
            k = index_kv_cache[page].float()
            qk = torch.einsum('qhd,kd->hqk', q[s:e], k)
            pos = blk * BS + arange_bs
            causal = abs_pos[:, None] >= pos[None, :]
            qk = torch.where(causal[None, :, :], qk, torch.full_like(qk, float('-inf')))
            score[:, s:e, blk] = qk.max(dim=-1).values
    return score
